entities.summary: Ottonian Renaissance, a transformative movement in Germany (843–1024). Emerged from Treaty of Verdun and Emergence of East Francia from the Treaty. Catalyzed Otto I crowned Emperor in Rome – founding of the HRE and Investiture Controversy.
